A catalog cannot answer every learner's next need.
2015: 129 of 221 collected courses reported completion; range 0.7%-52.1%. Public-data course-level median, no additions after Nov 2013. Not pooled learners, current India or Orbit outcomes.
The exact recent episode and number of friends were not supplied. We will not invent a quote, failed purchase or representative pain score.
For proposed learners aged 18+, test relevance, support and practical use separately. A missing catalog item does not automatically mean willingness to pay.
Credible alternatives; these limits are hypotheses to test, not competitor findings.
Over 14 days, record who, how and when. A convenience sample would remain nonrepresentative; targets are not completed research.
By day 45, stop if fewer than 3 mentors commit or fewer than 10 learners activate. These predeclared thresholds are proposals, not measured demand or approved pilot policy.
No primary survey data supplied. Personal/friends experience is origin, not respondents. Proposed 14 days: 12 learner interviews, 60 adult responses, 6 mentor conversations. No recruitment performed.
Ask about the last task, alternatives, cost, feedback and completion. Survey themes cover topic, urgency, schedule, format, support, price, commitment and consent.
Waitlists, willingness and completed payments are distinct. No respondent contacts belong in the repository.
Kill criteria are proposed discipline, not certainty. Record contradictions instead of selectively quoting supporters.
Report population, n, date, sampling and missing values. Quotes require permission. Until this happens, customer fit remains unvalidated; secondary studies cannot become our survey.
Demand first. Mentor response. A finite learning path.
Steps to connect demand with useful practice
Request, threshold, signal, build, learn + rate. Source requests/votes exist; integrated delivery, stronger waves and course reviews remain unproven. Animation does not establish mastery.
Claims of publication, completion and delivered notifications need exact runtime evidence.
One selected lesson route is visible. This screen does not demonstrate real playback, server grading, persisted progress or a completed learner outcome.
Retain 8 Student tiers and 6 Mentor divisions without inventing new names. Selected world redesign and five-or-six-thought destination transitions remain gated intent, not shipped features.
Request support is not a delivery guarantee. Confirm mentor capacity and a realistic launch window; current request and notification lifecycles need integration.
Catalogs, peer help and direct mentors remain credible alternatives; this combination is positioning, not a first-ever claim.
Four screens show interface work—not traction.
Journey, editor, student universe and idle studio: 3840×2160 originals, retained build, 16 Nov 2026. External traffic blocked; no backend/DB/media/provider operation. Screens are not traction.
Sample data: selected lesson and course-authoring rows. No playback, publication or persisted-completion proof.
Sample data: student universe and idle recorder. Not users or successful media capture.
Partial means source/wiring, not a percentage complete. No live operational certification is implied.
Interface work is visible. Next reproduce request → mentor response → reviewed course → persisted practice. No fresh full application suite, learning outcomes or bank settlement proven.
Traction, bank payouts and completion lift are unverified. A 25-payer day-90 target is conditional on commercial clearance; it is not revenue already earned.
One campus and one skill before a national story.
6.1 BASE PLANNING SCENARIO / NOT A FORECAST
Expected payers under synthetic base inputs

600 potential ×40% reach ×8% conversion =19.2 expected payers. Working INR 599 ×12 months gives INR 138,009.60 gross scenario. Fractional expectation is not people acquired; actual cohort count unknown.
Neither profile is a verified segment. First campus, city and skill must be selected before local recruitment or population claims.
Proposed boundaries reduce scope; they do not certify compliance. Test 1 campus, 1 skill and 2 launch cycles before expansion, with professional release review.
Coursera.com / 16 Nov + Brilliant.org / 16 Nov + Model estimate
Official pages observed 16 Nov 2026. Taxes and checkout specifics are not fully established. Different scope/billing means this is not affordability, quality or purchase-intent evidence.
All assume INR599 and 12 paid months, not observed retention. Base 19.2 expected payers is independent of the ambitious 25-payer day-90 target. Replace inputs with observed data before forecasting.
600 ×40% reach; conversion unmeasured. Sensitivity is not demand.
Mentor allocation is not platform profit.
Model estimate + Razorpay pricing + Cloudflare pricing
INR per payer per month after modeled variable costs

Working INR 599 / illustrative 1.18 tax base =INR 507.63;20% platform =101.53. Deductions:gateway 14.14, video 10.20, storage 8.50, AI 10, support 8. Tax, costs and allocation remain unapproved estimates.
7.2 WORKING PRICE POINTS, TO BE VALIDATED
Only mentors of eligible enrolled courses share that learner's pool. Source pricing copy conflicts; no live catalog, paid invoice or checkout success is asserted.
INR per payer. Totals and deductions; contribution before fixed costs.
Cloudflare pricing + Razorpay pricing + Model estimate
500 stored minutes still uses one 1,000 minute block; actual bills differ.
80% Core / 20% Premium learner mix. CM 63.36/month; Premium 114.02. Fixed costs / CM; no profit date.
Not guaranteed take-home. Eligibility, unit weights, refunds, rounding and provider contracts require approval; queued ledger intent is not bank transfer.
Ninety days should buy two testable launch cycles.
8.1 PROPOSED PILOT / RELATIVE START, NOT A DATE
Days to test two request-to-launch cycles

Proposed day30: 12 interviews, 60 responses, 6 mentor talks, 5 commitments, 2 courses, 30 prototype activations. Day60: 10 paid learners; day90: 25 and 2 cycles. Paid targets require cleared checkout; calendar start unselected.
Integration before charging; no actions executed.
Function unassigned. No outreach or partner agreement.
Measure completion, repeat use and cost separately. Current values are unknown unless explicitly reported; paid targets require payment clearance.
The INR100,000 proposal is staged across three tranches. At each gate, inspect receipts, usage and evidence. Unspent reserve stays unspent; exact dates and named owners remain unassigned.
Attach people and proof to every milestone.
No names, credentials, hours or count invented
A team is founder-reported. Member count, names, contributions and hours unknown. Four capability areas are functions, not fourpeople. Verify ownership and capacity before the 90 daylaunch.
Functions unassigned; source work is not individual attribution.
AI quiz router is unmounted; recurring checkout returns 503/501. Source has 3 identity paths, 8 Student tiers and 6 Mentor divisions, not proof of operational completeness.
9.5 CAPABILITY GAPS / HOW TO FILL THEM
Mentor introductions and qualified reviews are requested. No advisor appointment, partnership or endorsement has been made.

Before the day-1 launch gate, verify names, roles, contribution proof and availability. No invented biographies, photographs, credentials or institutional affiliation replace missing founder information.
INR100,000 to validate—not to assume scale.
INR for a bounded 90-day validation pilot
7 estimates:infra/support 45 k, courses 20 k, activation 8 k, review 7 k, testing 10 k, kit 2 k, reserve 8 k. No quotes/spending approval. Possible 200 k organizer ceiling is not an award.
10.2 USE OF FUNDS / ESTIMATES, NOT QUOTES
45 k +35 k +20 k =100 k. No spending approved.
Proposed introductions support 6 mentor conversations and 2 reviewed courses. Permissioned access to 1 adult cohort matters more than assumed nationwide reach. No partnerships are claimed.
Team, cohort, quotes and terms still need confirmation. Support is a proposal, not an award or spending approval.
